data: For fiscal 2023, Microsoft reported net income of $72,361 million (about $72.4 billion) and Amazon reported $30,425 million (about $30.4 billion), so Microsoft's figure was roughly 2.38 times Amazon's. The two fiscal years cover different periods. Microsoft's fiscal 2023 ended June 30, 2023, and Amazon's ended December 31, 2023. Microsoft's net income was nearly flat from $72,738 million in fiscal 2022. Amazon's swung sharply from a net loss of $2,722 million in fiscal 2022.
